metadata.name: The Locked Crossing — authored tracker example

story.style: A grounded local problem. Invent suitable people and a setting without raising the stakes beyond the crossing.

manual_compass.premise: A traveler must recover a missing passage token and cross a closed local crossing.
manual_compass.pressure: The crossing keeper has a practical reason for closing access; negotiation, retrieval, and alternative approaches remain possible.
manual_compass.possible_ending: The traveler reaches the other side, or passage becomes definitively impossible.

objective_tracker.name: Reach the other side
objective_tracker.instructions: These are goals, not a mandatory route. The traveler can negotiate, retrieve the token, earn another permission, or find a plausible alternative. Do not demand every optional milestone. No new conspiracy or cosmic threat. A failed check is only definitive failure when it truly closes all remaining routes.

objectives.title: Understand why passage was stopped
objectives.success: The traveler learns the keeper's actual practical objection.
objectives.failure: The reason can no longer be discovered in this adventure.

objectives.title: Recover the passage token
objectives.success: The traveler possesses the missing token.
objectives.failure: The token is irretrievably lost or destroyed.

objectives.title: Reach the other side
objectives.success: The traveler has crossed and can continue onward independently.
objectives.failure: Every plausible route across is definitively lost, or the traveler knowingly abandons the goal.

situations: A closed crossing with a practical obstruction.
details: An everyday object shows signs of use.
